title: Scaled Curve
tagline: A curve between two rails whose position across them changes along its length -- 30 % at the start, 70 % at the end, along a chosen transition.

slides.title: What it does
slides.problem: A mid-curve between two rails at a varying percentage is tedious by hand. Scaled Curve blends the rails point by point with a factor that travels from the initial to the final value.
useWhen: A character line drifting between two edges
slides.caption: SC3 and the three transition shapes.

slides.title: The dialog
params: First rail (edges joined); Flip? reverses it.
+ face: drop the result onto it.
Show ends / curves; output samples, tolerance, degree; input sampling.

slides.title: Example: SC3
slides.head: Arcs R100 and R200, scale factor 0
slides.body: An exact R150 arc (within 0.00062 mm) -- but only its first radian: the known arc bug. SC0: lines y = 0 and y = 100 -> y = 50; SC2: output degree 5.

keys: The scaled curve, named by Curve name.

items.head: Arcs: first radian only
items.body: On arc rails the result stops after 1 rad of each arc (bug; SC3 checks only the radius).

items.head: Matched by parameter
items.body: Not by length: uneven rails skew the blend. Orientation is manual (Flip).
